reviews.text: Both the teachers and staff are very kind.

This is a very reassuring animal hospital where the doctors and staff are all very kind and explain things carefully.

I would like to continue using this hospital as my regular veterinarian for checkups and vaccinations.
The teacher was very kind and explained things clearly to me, a foreigner, and even wrote out the kanji for me. I am very grateful for their kind assistance. Thank you very much.

My dog ​​has been living happily with us and has had almost no illnesses up until now, but for the past eight months he has been developing a series of skin diseases and ear infections, and he won't talk. He looks so miserable and I feel sorry for him, but I didn't know what was going on and it worried me so much that it gave me a headache.
Today the doctor here examined him, and he explained in detail the questions I had about the treatment, tests, and medication, and he also spoke to me gently when my dog ​​was acting up because he wasn't used to the tests. He has been a huge help and I am truly grateful.
I look forward to continuing to work with you.

It could be said that my precious child was treated carelessly and was abused. There are so many suspicious positive reviews, I just can't understand why my child has to go through something like this.
It's a veterinary clinic run by a very nice couple, I believe. My pet is always taken care of there.
Very nice doctor and nurse. Highly recommended
The doctor is kind to both people and animals and explains things to them well. I will be going to see him again.
Sensei is very kind. Although my Japanese is not great, he knows a little bit of English and using Google Translate helps with the rest. It is clear that he really loves the animals he treats!

A kind doctor and accurate treatment ❤️‍🩹
A great doctor was nearby. …
They are very kind. They will help with even the smallest things.
